data.title: Enfuvirtide
data.summary: Antivirals & ART · HIV fusion inhibitor (36-amino-acid synthetic peptide)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antivirals & ART_

**Class:** HIV fusion inhibitor (36-amino-acid synthetic peptide)

## Mechanism of action
- Binds the HR1 region of HIV gp41 → prevents the conformational change needed for fusion of virus and cell membranes → virus cannot enter CD4 cells

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Salvage therapy in heavily treatment-experienced patients with multidrug-resistant HIV (rarely used now)

## Dose & formulations
- 90 mg subcutaneously twice daily

## Adverse effects
- Injection-site reactions in almost all patients: painful erythematous nodules, induration, cysts (dermatology viva point)
- Increased bacterial pneumonia; hypersensitivity (rare)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data.

## Viva points
- The only injectable fusion inhibitor — injection-site nodules in ~98%

_Sources: Khopkar ch.4 (Enfuvirtide); Wolverton 4e ch.11. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
